legal_terms.title: TERMS OF PURCHASE & REMITTANCE POLICY
points: Payment is due strictly within 30 days of the invoice date ('Net 30'). Delinquent balances are subject to a late charge of 1.5% per month (18% per annum) or the maximum permitted by applicable law.
Title and ownership of all equipment and supplies remain with Seller until all invoiced amounts have been paid in full and irrevocably cleared in Seller's designated account.
Any claims for delivery discrepancy, shortage, or transit damages must be notified in writing within five (5) business days following physical receipt at the delivery destination.
Hardware items carry a 12-month manufacturer parts warranty. Any returns require a prior Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) issued by Seller; unapproved returns cannot be accepted.
Remit payments electronically via ACH or FedWire using the account instructions detailed in the Payment Details panel. Always state the Invoice Number on your remittance advice.
